value.rationale: Sphere volume is a natural exact invariant for this newly modeled local reordering channel. This theorem supplies an all-parameter center formula, a sharp alphabet threshold, and counts every maximizing center for arbitrary burst length; it also completely resolves the first nontrivial smaller-alphabet case with an exact volume distribution and moments. These facts are not implied by general redundancy asymptotics and can inform finite-length channel comparisons without requiring a code-construction theorem.
